explanation: The query index reads its corpus through scripts/lib/queryIndexCorpus.mts (added to the delivery sources): missing or malformed bundles are skipped and feed the no-partial-index guard, wrong-global bundles throw. The uploader's freshness and pointer reads, the reduced-release macaque check, the deploy verifier and the bundle optimizer parse through the bundle reader; the optimizer no longer evaluates bundles. Index output bytes are unchanged. Review follow-up: the reduced-release macaque check covers every track_<id>.js in the folder as well as the declared tracks, so a missing meta.js or an undeclared file cannot pass unchecked (deployGuards.test.ts).
